articles.title: Clock's ticking: UK's crypto regulatory application window opens with February deadline
articles.snippet: The five-month application window precedes the new regulatory framework’s planned introduction in October 2027, after years of legislative development.

articles.title: Bitcoin stalls near $83,000 while lighter drops 17% on Robinhood perps plan
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held near $83,000 as the 30-year Treasury yield topped 5.6%, while DeFi tokens reversed and lighter fell after Robinhood unveiled U.S. perps.

articles.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
articles.snippet: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.

articles.title: FCA opens crypto authorization window ahead of 2027 UK regime
articles.snippet: Crypto businesses should apply by Feb. 28, 2027, while existing money laundering registrations will not convert into FCA authorization.

articles.title: Cboe's New S&P Deal Opens the Door to Tokenized Options
articles.snippet: The renewed agreement preserves Cboe's exclusive rights to S&P 500 index options through 2051 while opening the door to pairing the flagship benchmark with blockchain infrastructure.
